verdict.rationale: CrewAI ships a CLI `crewai test` command that runs the crew for N iterations and reports performance metrics, which an engineering-lead could invoke from a CI pipeline, and observability docs mention 'evaluate' agents alongside monitoring/tracing. However there's no documented eval-scoring framework (rubrics, pass/fail thresholds, dataset-based scoring) or explicit CI-integration guide/example. Missing for 10: dedicated eval/grading framework with quality scores, CI pipeline examples/integration docs, independent evidence of running crewai test in CI.
